source: https://www.brunetbrothersconstruction.com/testimonials (copie Wayback du 13 juillet 2026), mot pour mot, sans signature (la page n’en a pas)
quotes: We are so happy that we chose the BBC to remodel our kitchen. After weeks of searching for the right company, and most of all, the right price, we found Brunet Brothers. They turned my vision into reality. Thanks!

Brunet Brothers just completed my bathroom remodeling and the entire experience was amazing. From the very first moment, we felt very comfortable moving forward with our bathroom project. We left Carlos a copy of our key and our place was always spotless. Thank you!
Our kitchen looks amazing. I could not have asked for more. I love that I can show it off proudly. You won't believe how many compliments I have received. Will recommend to everyone. Job well done.

I used Brunet Brothers Construction to renovate our house. The staff were always on time and did a fantastic job. The designer gave us ideas, was professional and answered all our questions. He designed the kitchen and bathrooms for us and his expertise made our rooms perfect. We loved the workmanship and the experience. Thank you.

We used BB Construction for three projects. First was the kitchen and Laundry Room, then the Master Bathroom and last year the Guest Bathroom or a Laundry Room. Every single project turned out very well. The team at BB Construction is very professional and courteous.

I had my Master Bathroom done 2 years ago. It came out better than expected. They designed the bathroom to look better than average. Then they coordinated the plumber, electrician, countertop, and even the frameless glass door to arrive when it was the correct time. Now, 2 years later, they are doing my kitchen. They really are excellent.

I had shopped all the companies in our area until I finally saw Brunet Brothers Construction. From the moment I meet them I felt so comfortable and knew I could work with them to build my kitchen. They were very honest and cared about making my dream kitchen happen. I would highly recommend them. They not only did an outstanding job but became good friends.

We were a little nervous when we first decided to remodel my home. We didn't know how long it would take and we didn't want to go over the budget, but we were surprised. The Brunet Brothers team worked quickly and professionally. I recommend them.
I love my kitchen. The quality of the materials and the workmanship was super. I would recommend them anytime. I’ll go back when it's time to redo my bath.
I just wanted to thank you for everything. I love how everything came together. You were great to work with.

We had both our kitchen and bath complete with BBC after being referred by one of our neighbors who had their kitchen done by them. What a great experience! We were able to give them the keys to our home & when we returned after the summer we were astounded to find they had even a cleaning crew go in afterward!
Thanks for being able to finish both my kitchen and bathroom so quickly. I didn't think it could be done during such a busy time of the year. I really appreciate it.
Outstanding experience with the Brothers. They came to our house multiple times. They explained the process and answered all of our questions. Thank you.

Go with Brunet Brothers. They take you step-by-step through the entire design process and they have wonderful ideas. They not only cared about my kitchen, but they also cared about me. I was very happy.

Friendly personalized service from start to finish. They even dropped off samples for us to consider. Delivery of baseboards and product occurred when they said it would. Great people. Very kind and a pleasure to deal with. Reliable and honest. Highly recommend them.
Everyone we met from Brunet Brothers was professional and friendly. And I must say, I still get a thrill every time I walk into my new bathroom!

I had my master bathroom done by Brunet Brothers Construction. They provided me with references for my flooring, plumbing, and electrical works. All were coordinated by only one person and everything was done with ease and I never had to wait around, they scheduled the job so well to tie into my work schedule. I was very impressed.

Brunet Brothers Construction was recommended to us by friends who used them. They exceeded our expectations. Our complete house remodeling came out beautiful. They worked around our work schedule, very professional and pleasant. The workmanship was excellent and clean.
